title: High-gain erbium-doped traveling-wave fiber amplifier
lineage: Publisher’s original abstract, author affiliations and bibliographic history were available.

passages.locator: Optics Letters 12(11), pp. 888–890, author affiliations, History and abstract
passages.note: Bell Labs scientists reported 22 dB gain on a 1.53 μm optical signal in erbium-doped single-mode fibre at room temperature. The catalogue gives submission on 18 June, acceptance on 12 August and publication on 1 November. The experiment had already been performed by publication.
